messages:
Priya: FYI vendor GreenSpark Labs submitted invoice INV-2025-019 for $12,750 but AP can't match a PO. Approver routed to #product-growth instead of Procurement. Vendor is flagging overdue (Net30 passed). Putting in thread to unblock.
invoice-bot: New invoice received: INV-2025-019 | amount: $12,750 | vendor: GreenSpark Labs | uploaded by vendor portal.
Dan M.: can you attach the PDF? I'll look up PO mapping.
Priya: attaching — link: https://redwood.share/invoices/INV-2025-019.pdf (internal only). The PO the vendor referenced on the invoice is `PO-7789` but our ERP search returns nothing: `SELECT * FROM pos WHERE po_number='PO-7789'`
Elena (Procure): thats odd — I see a PO-7789 in Concur but it's closed under legal entity 'Redwood EU' and vendor was set to 'GreenSpark US' so it didn't match. @trevor-k did we recently change vendor entity mapping?
trevor-k: yes, we migrated vendor account for Greenspark to consolidated vendor id GS-01 last quarter; seems like the invoice used the old vendor name. Will update mapping and re-run matching.
Priya: AP system still has GL code mismatch (invoice GL 6112 vs PO GL 6210). Even if we remap vendor, approver routing rules use GL to pick approver and it's choosing Product Growth. We need approver to be Procurement and GL to be recoded to Infra (6210).
Dan M.: @Elena can you confirm who the approver should be? Procurement signs off infra SOWs, right?
Elena (Procure): Procurement should approve. I'll change approver for that PO to @Dan M. manually and update GL to 6210. Once updated, AP re-run should auto-match. Will take ~20 mins.
Priya: vendor wants payment ETA today. Can we escalate payment after manual match? If not, we should at least send vendor a receipt/ack.
trevor-k: I can create a manual match in AP and push for expedited pay. But we need PO confirmation from procurement — tagging @Dan M.
Dan M.: I'll approve once Elena updates. Also recommend we add note to vendor: payment in process. @Priya can you send vendor message? I don't want them to suspend service.
Priya: sending now. Message: 'Thanks — we've matched your invoice and initiated expedited payment. Expect funds in 3 business days. If you have remittance questions cc: payments@redwood.com' :thumbsup:
Elena (Procure): updated PO/GL and approver. Manual match created. @invoice-bot can you re-ingest?
invoice-bot: Re-ingested INV-2025-019 — status: Matched (manual). Payment queued for expedited release. Processing ETA 2025-06-17.
Dan M.: thanks all. Quick note: ops — can we add a rule to map old vendor aliases to GS-01 to avoid this in future?
trevor-k: will add alias mapping and open a change with Accounts Payable to prefer PO vendor id over invoice free-text vendor.
Priya: closing loop — vendor confirmed receipt of payment notice. Marking thread resolved; will follow up with retrospective on mapping gap.
